description: Records the primary cancer condition, the original or first neoplasm in the body (Definition from: [NCI Dictionary of Cancer Terms](https://www.cancer.gov/publications/dictionaries/cancer-terms/def/primary-tumor)). Cancers that are not clearly secondary (i.e., of uncertain origin or behavior) should be documented as primary.

element.definition: Most recent overall cancer stage, such as stage group IIA in TNM staging. More detailed staging information (such as the individual T, N, and M categories) SHOULD be captured in a separate Observation resource, referenced by stage.assessment, conforming to CancerStage profile.
element.short: Stage at time of last staging.

element.definition: The type of stage reported in stage.summary, or the staging method used to arrive at the stage.summary value.
element.short: The type of stage Staging system or method used.

element.orderMeaning: If more than one code or Reference is present, it is interpreted as the the physician's declaration of how the cancer was diagnosed, with the most invasive method first (e.g., autopsy/histopathology, cytology, radiology, physicial exam, etc.)

name: PrimaryCancerCondition
title: Primary Cancer Condition Profile
